business_summary: NAURA Technology Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and technical services of semiconductors in the People's Republic of China. It operates through Semiconductor Equipment, Vacuum New Energy Equipment, and Precision Component segments. The company offers semiconductor process equipment including etching, thin film deposition, thermal processing, wet cleaning, ion implantation, coating and developing, and bonding which are used in the manufacturing of integrated circuits, power semiconductors, 3D integration and advanced packaging, compound semiconductors, and new displays. It also provides vacuum new energy equipment, which includes crystal growth, vacuum heat treatment, atmosphere-protected heat treatment, continuous heat treatment, plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition, diffusion oxidation annealing, magnetron sputtering coating, low-pressure chemical vapor deposition, multi-arc ion plating, and metal bipolar plate coating equipment that are used in material heat treatment, vacuum electronics, semiconductor materials, magnetic materials, and new energy fields. In addition, the company offers precision components including precision resistors, new capacitors, ultra-high voltage ceramic capacitors, quartz crystal devices, quartz microelectromechanical sensors, analog chips, modular power supplies, microwave components, inductors and transformers, and high-performance magnetic materials which are used in power electronics, rail transportation, smart grids, precision instruments, and automatic control applications. The company was formerly known as Beijing Sevenstar Electronics Co., Ltd. and changed its name to NAURA Technology Group Co., Ltd. in February 2017. NAURA Technology Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Beijing, the People's Republic of China.
business_summary_ko: NAURA Technology Group Co., Ltd.는 중화인민공화국에서 반도체 연구개발, 생산, 판매 및 기술 서비스를 제공합니다. 반도체 장비, 진공 신에너지 장비, 정밀 부품 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 집적회로, 전력 반도체, 3D 통합 및 첨단 패키징, 화합물 반도체, 신규 디스플레이 제조에 사용되는 에칭, 박막 증착, 열 처리, 습식 세정, 이온 주입, 코팅 및 현상, 본딩 등의 반도체 공정 장비를 제공합니다. 또한, 재료열처리, 진공전자공학, 반도체재료, 자성재료 및 신에너지 분야에 사용되는 결정성장, 진공열처리, 대기보호열처리, 연속열처리, 플라즈마 강화 화학기상증착, 확산산화어닐링, 마그네트론 스퍼터링 코팅, 저압화학기상증착, 멀티아크 이온 도금, 금속분리판 코팅 장비 등 진공 신에너지 장비를 제공하고 있습니다. 또한, 회사는 정밀 수지를 포함한 정밀 부품을 제공합니다.
